limits: Coverage/identity is intrusive and separate from CPU profiling. No ordinary performance comparison.
Categories use exact saved compiled function ranges; exclusive sampled weights are disjoint, inclusive weights overlap.
Framework work is an upper bound for scene reconciliation, not a proven count/cost for each leaf.
Zero DOM mutations does not prove no React work; a root commit with unchanged JSpaceMap props does not prove that component itself rendered.
Clock and same-revision pilot/observation changes passed; dropping these inputs is unsound.

Reported precise-coverage callback counts are not uniformly component-call-count times graph cardinality (for example 1615 edge calls vs1646 minimap edge calls); preserve raw counts and do not treat them as a complete render census.
Reported V8 invocation counts are not uniformly component calls times collection cardinality; preserve the counts without claiming a perfect leaf-render census.
